Work With Us

Booking

GCE pitches a partnership model for venues and promoters: no booking fee charged to the venue — revenue comes from the door. Tell us about your event and we’ll build your email draft.

1
Send an inquiry

Use the form — it creates an email to bookgce@gmail.com with everything we need. No account, no spam list.

2
We check the date

Availability and fit are confirmed by management before any price or promise is made.

3
Lock it in

Performance time, requirements, and door split agreed in writing — then we promote it together.
